notes.title: Escape from DuFo will be free!
notes.notes:
[h1]Escape from DuFo will be free![/h1]

Greetings to all!
Soon [b]Escape from DuFo will be free for everyone[/b], forever!
[b]Thanks to everyone[/b] for your interest in the game, and [b]special thanks to those who bought it[/b] and supported the author!
